title: Oracle local configuration
statement: Given a Boolean input list $x$, a tape-content function $f:\mathbb Z\to\mathrm{Option}(\mathrm{Bool})$, an integer $p$, a dispatch state $q$, an input-head position among the $|x|+2$ positions, and an output list, define a four-work-tape configuration in state $q$ with that input-head position and output. Its first tape has contents $f$, its second has the fixed origin contents, and its last two tapes are blank; the first two heads are at $p$ and the other two are at $0$.
caveat: The fixed origin contents are referenced in the definition but are not defined in the supplied payload.
